claims.text: Mastitis is a clinical diagnosis from history and exam; distinguish it from engorgement without inflammation or infection.
claims.quote: Diagnosis of mastitis is by history and physical examination. Mastitis must be differentiated from breast engorgement without inflammation or infection.

claims.text: Breast ultrasound to diagnose an abscess, which is drained by needle aspiration or incision.
claims.quote: Breast abscesses are diagnosed by ultrasound and are treated mainly with drainage via needle aspiration or surgical incision.

claims.text: Milk culture only rarely: no abscess and no improvement on antibiotics.
claims.quote: In rare situations when there is no abscess and the patient is not improving with antibiotics, milk culture can be done.

claims.text: Pregnancy test for unexplained breast pain of less than several months.
claims.quote: Pregnancy testing should be performed if pain is unexplained and has lasted less than several months

claims.text: Other testing only when the breast exam finds something abnormal.
claims.quote: Other testing is indicated infrequently—only if breast examination detects abnormal findings.
